title: Mauler Invasion
source: camelot.allakhazam.com/quests.html?cquest=2451 (retold in our own words; the 27 copper and the experience, 5 at level 1 and 20 at level 2, are from its log: a tenth of a level)
offer: The black mauler cubs have grown bold around the village. Thin them out, and bring me two of their pelts to show it.

steps.text: Hunt black mauler cubs near Mularn for two pelts.
Bring the two pelts to Viking Kreimhilde.
